title: The 3 Best Travel Adapters Under $40
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for travel adapters under $40, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel adapters under $40 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter M8 Max
products.blurb: Key specs: 2 USA outlets, 3 USB-A ports, 1 USB-C PD 18W port, Interchangeable plug attachments for 150+ countries, Grounded 3-prong design.
strengths: 18W USB-C PD is a genuine speed upgrade over basic USB-A-only budget adapters
Grounded design covers laptop chargers safely
limitations: 18W USB-C still isn't enough to fast-charge a laptop directly
Larger than a minimal single-outlet budget adapter

products.name: BESTEK Universal Travel Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: 100-220V to 110V step-down voltage conversion, 250W, 6A 4-port USB charging, 3 AC sockets.
strengths: The only model in this list that performs genuine voltage conversion, not just plug adaptation
250W ceiling covers most single-voltage travel appliances
Three AC sockets plus four USB ports cover a full device load
